info.title: APISIX Admin API
info.description: APISIX Admin API is a RESTful API that allows you to create and manage APISIX resources.

tags.name: Route
tags.description:
A route defines a path to one or more upstream services.  
  
See [Routes](/apisix/key-concepts/routes) for more information.

tags.name: Upstream
tags.description:
An upstream is a logical abstraction of one or more upstream addresses.  
  
See [Upstreams](/apisix/key-concepts/upstreams) for more information.

tags.name: Service
tags.description:
A service is a backend application providing a set of functionalities.  
  
See [Services](/apisix/key-concepts/services) for more information.

tags.name: Consumer
tags.description:
A consumer represents a user, application, or host that sends requests to the API gateway and consumes backend services.  
  
See [Consumers](/apisix/key-concepts/consumers) for more information.

tags.name: Consumer Group
tags.description:
A consumer group is a group of consumers sharing the same plugin configurations.  
  
See [Consumer Groups](/apisix/key-concepts/consumer-groups) for more information.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description:
A credential is an entity used to store authentication configurations associated with consumers.  
  
See [Credentials](/apisix/key-concepts/credentials) for more information.

tags.name: Plugin
tags.description:
Plugins extend base functionalities of APISIX to meet user-specific requirements.  
  
See [Plugins](/apisix/key-concepts/plugins) for more information.

tags.name: Plugin Config
tags.description:
Plugin config is used to configure plugin configurations that can be shared among other objects, such as routes.  
  
See [Plugin Configs](/apisix/key-concepts/plugin-configs) for more information.

tags.name: Plugin Metadata
tags.description:
Plugin metadata is used to configure the common metadata field(s) of all plugin instances sharing the same plugin name.  
  
See [Plugin Metadata](/apisix/key-concepts/plugin-metadata) for more information.

tags.name: Global Rule
tags.description:
A plugin global rule is used to create plugins that are triggered on every incoming request and executed before other plugins locally bound to objects, such as routes, services, consumers, consumer groups, or plugin configs.  
  
See [Global Rules](/apisix/key-concepts/plugin-global-rules) for more information.

tags.name: Stream Route
tags.description:
A stream route defines a path to one or more upstream services when APISIX functions as a stream proxy that operates on the transport layer for TCP and UDP connections.  
  
See [Stream Routes](/apisix/key-concepts/stream-routes) for more information.

tags.name: SSL
tags.description:
An SSL certificate in Admin API is required to configure TLS or mTLS with client applications and configure mTLS with upstream services.  
  
See [SSL](/apisix/key-concepts/ssl-certificates) for more information.

tags.name: Secret
tags.description:
Secret is used to set up integration with an external secret manager, so that APISIX can establish connections and fetch secrets from the secret manager dynamically at runtime.  
  
See [Secrets](/apisix/key-concepts/secrets) for more information.

tags.name: Proto
tags.description:
Proto is used to store protocol buffer (protobuf) definitions which define the service interface and message types used in communication with upstream gRPC services.  
  
See [Protos](/apisix/key-concepts/protos) for more information.

tags.name: Schema Validation
tags.description: Validate if the schema of a configuration is correct without sending a request to the Admin API for resource creation. This API can be used with all Admin API resources.
